jobs.description:
Join a dynamic and fast-growing international company where innovation, entrepreneurship, and ambition are at the heart of everything. You'll have the opportunity to build a global network, make a real impact, and accelerate your career in an inspiring environment.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients.

• Optometrist

• Hunter profile

This international company specializes in the production and supply of plastic components for the automotive industry, including injection-moulded parts for vehicles.

Jobomschrijving

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machine park.

You will work in a two-shift system:
	
• Early shift: 06:00–14:00	
• Late shift: 14:00–22:00
As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your expertise, production processes remain reliable and downtime is kept to a minimum.

Your tasks and responsibilities
	
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.	
• Troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.	
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical breakdowns.	
• Analysing faults and looking for sustainable solutions.	
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.	
• Actively contributing to optimizations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machine park.	
• Working closely with the production department to minimize downtime.	
• Working according to applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.	
• Helping to maintain a clean, safe and well-organized working environment.

You have a strong technical background and enjoy working hands-on.

In addition, you have:
	
• A technical qualification in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering, Automation or a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.	
• Experience in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery.	
• Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.	
• Basic knowledge of PLC control systems is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to develop this knowledge internally.	
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but is not required.	
• A good command of Dutch.	
• The ability to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.	
• Strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.	
• A hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.	
• Good team spirit combined with the ability to carry out interventions independently.

jobs.occupation: Forklift Driver | Mechelen | NL or ENG
jobs.description:

• Administrative processing in Excel and Word

What are we looking for in you? 

 
• You understand and speak Dutch or English fluently 
 

 
• You have experience operating EPT, stacker, and forklift

• You are familiar with WMS systems, scanners, Excel, and Word

•  
You are physically able to lift heavier objects

Early shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM Late shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM 

OR in a night shift system:

10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

It is possible that you will be asked to work on weekends as well, so some availability and flexibility are required.

Are you passionate about industrial technology and do you gain energy from solving technical challenges?

For our sites in Neder-over-Heembeek and Brucargo, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician who maintains and optimises industrial installations with dedication and expertise.

You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability of our technical systems. We invest in safety, training and your development, and we value your technical expertise. Together, we build a future based on innovation, reliability and teamwork.

Your responsibilities

 
• Preventive maintenance: carry out preventive maintenance according to the maintenance plan and inspect machines to avoid breakdowns.
 
• Corrective & improvement maintenance: analyse and resolve faults, replace or adjust parts, consult technical documentation and ensure optimal machine performance.
 
• Optimisation: analyse recurring issues and propose improvement actions to increase performance and availability.
 
• Use of CMMS: record interventions, write fault analyses, prepare reports and monitor stock levels.
 
• Safety: ensure a clean and safe working environment and actively contribute to safety improvements.
 
• Support & training: provide technical support to colleagues and operational teams.
 
• Quality & environment: work in accordance with current procedures (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001).

 
• Solid technical background (mechanics, electricity or electromechanics). 
 
• Autonomous, thorough and solution‑oriented. 
 
• Experience with industrial installations is an asset. Knowledge of CMMS systems is a plus. 
 
• Strong safety awareness, quality‑oriented and eager to learn. 
 
• Willing to work in a 3‑shift system (Mon–Fri). 
 
• Excellent command of English; knowledge of French / Dutch is an advantage
